prose:
Ben Thompson's Stratechery update is titled Amazon Earnings, The Chip Question, About Agents. Its public deck says Amazon presents itself as different from other compute providers while signaling a willingness to sacrifice margin to serve frontier demand.

The accessible page exposes that deck and subscription material rather than the analysis. Earnings figures, the chip argument and the proposed role of agents cannot be reconstructed from headings. A public page returning substantial navigation text is not full article access. This entry preserves the topic and stated framing without inventing Thompson's reasoning or conclusions.
highlights: The public deck frames Amazon's compute positioning
It mentions willingness to give up margin
The body of the update was not accessible
Subscription and navigation text do not supply the argument
No earnings analysis or agent thesis is inferred from the title
